rules: Use existing reviewed Prisma models before introducing new storage.
Every query and mutation must include the active tenant and authenticated user context.
Approval queues and decisions must be restricted to the reviewer role's operational domain.
The proposer cannot approve their own proposal and prohibited proposals cannot be approved.
AI responses are read-only, evidence-based and prompt-injection guarded.
Actions that change records remain approval proposals until an authorised human decides.
Do not fabricate unsupported finance, library, student or operational records.
